acceptance.decision_rule: A cell is resolved only when every coarse/fine gate passes and, if selected, its centered finite-difference spot check passes.

discrepancy_norms.finite_difference_gram: ||G_FD-G_fine||_F / max(1,||G_fine||_F), evaluated only at declared spots
discrepancy_norms.finite_difference_response: ||R_FD-R_fine||_F / max(1,||R_fine||_F), evaluated only at declared spots
discrepancy_norms.finite_difference_strongest_gain: |sigma_max_FD-sigma_max_fine| / sigma_max_fine, evaluated only at declared spots
discrepancy_norms.finite_difference_weakest_gain: |sigma_min_FD-sigma_min_fine| / sigma_min_fine, evaluated only at declared spots

acceptance.finite_difference_scope: centered finite differences are evaluated only at the declared spot-check cells, not at every resolved grid cell

proof_boundary: All gains, Grams, refinement decisions, and finite-difference checks are Tier-1 floating-point evidence. Coarse/fine agreement is not an outward error enclosure, and unresolved masking is not a proof that resolved cells contain the exact flow response. No Lyapunov, infinite-time, or exact OIG-certificate claim is made.

protocol.phase_sensor: identity on (sin theta1, cos theta1, sin theta2, cos theta2, omega1/scale, omega2/scale)
protocol.rms_feature_equivalence: The information Gram equals the Euclidean pullback Gram of trajectory_feature with the same samples, weights, and velocity scale.
